cases.label: REFUSE: absolute path outside project
cases.text: bb_index: refusing a path outside the project. "/etc/hostname" resolves to /etc/hostname, which is not inside /home/ishaq2321/mcp/backbencher-brain/validation/tools/bb_index/work/t0-polyglot. bb_index indexes THIS project's files; an out-of-tree path would be stored with a "project-relative" path that is not relative to anything, and every scoped query, file name and freshness check in the index would then be wrong for it.

PROBE: mode=post with a FILE path (schema says project)

bbIndex.pathDescription: Project-relative file (reindex only that file) or directory (incremental index of changed files); for mode=post, the project whose derived phases should be re-run. REQUIRED in every mode, and for mode=post it is checked rather than ignored. Must resolve INSIDE the project: both sides are resolved through realpath, so a symlink inside the project pointing out of it is refused too.
